description: The question that sounds silly at seven is often the research question at twenty. I still keep a list of my "dictionary questions" — AI & ML is simply where I finally get to answer them.
A drop year taught me that isolation happens to you, but solitude is something you build. Deep work, hard proofs and 2 a.m. debugging all require the second kind.

I build small things constantly — a reading app, a shared-listening room, a login-free call tool, this site — because one shipped project teaches you what ten tutorials can't: what breaks, what scales, and what people actually do.
